verdict.rationale: incident.io publishes its own API reference that documents endpoints with usage examples, authentication, rate limits and error handling (docs-86, docs-20), and offers a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec (docs-34). Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-browser. The probe's 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented download. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/runnable request console, hands-on or independent corroboration of the reference experience.
